SELECT d.*, owner.employee_name AS owner_name, proposer.employee_name AS proposer_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rel_demand_course rc WHERE rc.demand_id = d.id) AS course_count FROM biz_demand d LEFT JOIN org_employee owner ON owner.employee_no = d.owner_no AND owner.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN org_employee proposer ON proposer.employee_no = d.proposer_no AND proposer.deleted = FALSE
ORDER BY d.${sortColumn} ${sortDirection} NULLS LAST, d.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
